name: Luna REST API Development
updateContentCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y wget gnupg ca-certificates lsb-release build-essential redis-server luarocks lua5.3 liblua5.3-dev lua-cjson && sudo mkdir -p /etc/apt/keyrings && wget -qO- https://openresty.org/package/pubkey.gpg | sudo gpg --dearmor -o /etc/apt/keyrings/openresty.gpg && echo 'deb [signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/openresty.gpg] http://openresty.org/package/ubuntu noble main' | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/openresty.list && sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y openresty
postStartCommand: sudo service redis-server start && sudo openresty -p . -c conf/nginx.conf
